undeclared.decision: Fixed-clock delay is the per-clip lag minimizing mean fingertip distance over integer lags 0–5, summarized by the median across clips. Each lag uses its remaining overlapping frames.

The output field names and lag_note correctly expose the restriction, but the assumption ledger does not.
